selection.municipal: All 150 from the previously published provenance-backed roster: 51 Nuevo Leon and 99 Jalisco.
selection.historical: All 30 historical-report selection cases from the frozen 60-person notary cohort; not all 30 are confirmed incident positives.
selection.comparators: Retain all prior 30 random CDMX comparators, including any subsequently found historical reports.

limitations: Purposive geographic and historical strata; not a national representative prevalence sample.
Roster roles are as reported at the source cutoff; current tenure or active professional authorization is not certified.
Historical selection and prior 60-person gold are reused diagnostics, not independent held-out data.
No negative personal labels have been certified. No news means unknown coverage, never absence of risk.
Roster provenance URLs must not be seeded as news candidates or supplied as gold discovery answers.
No prior article text, labels, scores or source captures are imported into the new production bank.
additional_limits: The NL directory reports the office heading Responsable de Presidencia Municipal; imported presidente municipal is a role hint, not a literal verified title for every row.
The Jalisco publication records election outcomes for 2024–2027, not uninterrupted individual tenure.
The CDMX college directory is a professional directory, not a licensing-authority certification.
Some historical context URLs are prior news references. They were not used as discovery seeds; use_context=false and aliases=[] in the cold plan.
